entries.meaningZh: 邻友聚集剥玉米壳的集会〔美国旧式乡村活动〕
entries.en: Neighbors sang together during the evening husking bee.
entries.zh: 傍晚的剥玉米壳集会上，邻居们一起唱起了歌。

entries.en: The eye model included a transparent hyaloid membrane.
entries.zh: 眼球模型中有一层透明的玻璃体膜。

entries.en: The field trial compared hybrid vigor in several corn crosses.
entries.zh: 田间试验比较了几个玉米杂交组合的杂种优势。

entries.en: The veterinary archive contained a regional survey of hydatid disease.
entries.zh: 兽医档案中有一份地区性棘球蚴病调查报告。

entries.en: The pathology exhibition included a preserved hydatidiform mole.
entries.zh: 病理展览中有一件保存的葡萄胎标本。

entries.en: The hospital's hyperbaric chamber was closed for an equipment inspection.
entries.zh: 医院的高压舱因设备检查而暂停使用。

entries.en: The artist used hyperbolic geometry to design the repeating pattern.
entries.zh: 艺术家运用双曲几何设计了那个重复图案。

entries.meaningZh: 高色指数性贫血〔旧医学分类用语〕
entries.en: The old hematology report classified the case as hyperchromic anemia.
entries.zh: 那份旧血液学报告将该病例归类为高色指数性贫血。

entries.en: The research team reviewed hospital records of hyperemesis gravidarum.
entries.zh: 研究团队查阅了医院的妊娠剧吐病例记录。

entries.meaningZh: 运动过度综合征〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical study examined changing descriptions of hyperkinetic syndrome.
entries.zh: 这项历史研究考察了对运动过度综合征的描述如何变化。

entries.en: The laboratory teaching file included cases of hypochromic anemia.
entries.zh: 实验室教学档案中包含低色指数性贫血病例。

entries.en: A sealed hypodermic needle remained in its original package.
entries.zh: 一根密封的皮下注射针仍放在原包装里。

entries.en: The antique anatomical plate labeled the hypogastric artery in red.
entries.zh: 那幅古老的解剖图用红色标出了腹下动脉。

entries.en: The lecturer traced the hypoglossal nerve on the specimen.
entries.zh: 讲师在标本上沿着舌下神经辨认其走向。

entries.en: The magnified image clearly showed the hypophyseal stalk.
entries.zh: 放大的图像清楚地显示了垂体茎。

entries.meaningZh: 垂体性侏儒〔旧医学称谓，可能冒犯〕
entries.en: The old casebook described the patient as a hypophysial dwarf.
entries.zh: 那本旧病例集把患者描述为“垂体性侏儒”。

entries.en: The archived study compared several cases of hypoplastic anemia.
entries.zh: 那项存档研究比较了几例再生不良性贫血病例。
